subject.title: [Feature]: Ali bailian coding plan support ( thinking/reasoning enabled )

question: Should OpenClaw officially enable reasoning for Ali Bailian/Qwen Coding Plan models in the bundled Qwen provider, and if so which endpoint/model set is supported?
rationale: Current source still blocks most Coding Plan reasoning, while open PRs cover different partial slices; maintainers need to choose the official support boundary before automation should open another competing fix PR.

options.title: Define and land a scoped Coding Plan policy
options.body: Approve a model-by-model Coding Plan reasoning support boundary, land or adapt the existing PR slices, and update docs/tests together.

options.title: Keep only custom-provider opt-in
options.body: Land the custom-provider compatibility fix while leaving bundled Coding Plan catalog rows conservative until vendor support is proven per model and endpoint.

options.title: Defer official support
options.body: Keep the issue open as a product request and ask users to use documented custom-provider config until maintainers can verify Alibaba's current Coding Plan contract.

recommendation.title: Define and land a scoped Coding Plan policy
recommendation.body: Approve a model-by-model Coding Plan reasoning support boundary, land or adapt the existing PR slices, and update docs/tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced and recently maintained the Qwen provider surface and authored prior routing guidance on this issue.
